informal_statement: The normalized arc saving from combining two equal-area caps.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At GFunction.lean:115-118, the source contract is `noncomputable def g (x : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * arc x - arc (2 * x)`. The normalized saving is 2*L(X)-L(2*X) on X > 0. The factor of two in the chain rule and the principal inverse-cap-angle domain are retained; none of the geometric inequalities is extended to nonpositive cap area.
